paper_title: Search for Axion-Like Particles produced in $e^+e^-$ collisions at Belle II
notes: Belle II search for e+e- -> gamma a, a -> gamma gamma sets 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma at the level of 1e-3 GeV^-1 in mass range 0.2 < m_a < 9.7 GeV. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. However, no numerical table of limit vs mass is in the provided text (referred to Supplemental textfile); data points are approximate based on stated ~1e-3 GeV^-1 level. This is a collider production search, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed. Mass converted GeV to eV.
